title: Early farm: in the first 60 s, walk to cubes harder while keeping early spacing (EARLY_FARM_ON)
source: Mech Watcher ladder update 11:38 PM ET (PR #152 comment 7074455224): winners alive at 60 s had 4.2 vs 2.2 cubes, 1.9 vs 1.2 upgrades; kept ~145 m nearest-enemy spacing in the first 30 s
change: From 10 s to 60 s, when the champion has no farm goal: walk to the nearest zone-safe cube within 120 m (champion farm reach is 80 m) if every enemy in view or known in the last 10 s is more than 145 m away and no mech hit us for 3 s. The champion's farm gate requires no enemy in view at all. Drops, hunt, and every other mode are unchanged and keep priority.
distinct_from: B12/B13 (farm gate, no enemy in view), B21 (upgrade order), P23b (late idle farm)
coordinator_note: Near-miss data test 12:47 AM ET Sun by 10-minute loop. LOSS −0.21. PR closed.
decision: Near-miss data test submitted 12:47 AM ET by the 10-minute loop (one veto: drop-ring 8→3 on 2000+3000). Site 4.23 vs 4.44 (BB-0AB39656), LOSS (−0.21). PR closed. Findings N3: the drop-ring loss was real, and the sim early-death gain (48→45) did not carry over. Don't build on F11 as-is; F8 stays a ladder signal only.
next_action: None. Do not repeat this early-farm-with-enemies-in-view mechanism as built.
hypothesis: In the first 60 s, walking to cubes harder while keeping early spacing should cut early deaths and raise early upgrades (findings F8; P52.json source: Watcher 11:38 PM ET, winners alive at 60 s had 4.2 vs 2.2 cubes and 1.9 vs 1.2 upgrades).
mechanism: EARLY_FARM_ON as specified in P52.json change. SHA 74b6ee4, PR #169.
activation: Mac screen: different behaviour 26 and 22 of 192.
positives: Mac screen only (did not transfer): died<40 s 48→45 and 38→37; means +0.047 and +0.016 (F11).

p52b.title: Early farm with drop safety: P52 early farm (EARLY_FARM_ON) where an active drop run (drop near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M) always takes priority, and early farm never picks a cube that would put us beyond the drop-run margin from an active drop
p52b.stage: retired (outcome C: tick-identical to P52; Coordinator 1:10 AM ET Nov 22)
p52b.why: P52 #169 cut deaths <40 s (48->45, 38->37) but lost drop arrivals (8->3 on 2000+3000).
p52b.source: Coordinator brief 12:47 AM ET Sun Nov 22; P52 code from 911a662 (brain.ts, params.ts)
p52b.hypothesis: P52's early-death gain (F11) can be kept without its drop-ring loss (N3, site 4.23 vs 4.44) if the early farm never pulls us away from a drop the drop run could take.
p52b.mechanism: Same early-farm trigger as P52 (10-60 s, no farm goal, all enemies in view or known in 10 s beyond 145 m, no mech hit for 3 s, nearest zone-safe cube within 120 m). Added inside EARLY_FARM_ON: no early farm while a drop run is on; with a drop near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M (the drop run's own candidate filter), a cube is allowed only if it stays within DROP_RUN_M of that drop and (me->cube->drop)/walk_speed + 5 s < lands_in, so a landed reachable drop blocks early farm and the drop run always wins.
p52b.positives: Practice bases, trees-on, vs champion b9492c6: base 0 paired +0.208 +/- 0.107 (7 better / 1 worse), died<40 s 24->23, kills 293->313; base 6000 +0.188 +/- 0.090 (7/1), died<40 s 16->15, survivors 0->1, kills 358->374. Drop-ring arrivals equal (5->5, 1->1).
p52b.negatives: The drop-safety gate is inert: drops are called at t=70/140/210 s (kit config drops.times) and the early-farm window ends at 60 s, so obs.drops is always empty while early farm can fire. P52b is tick-identical to P52 (74b6ee4) on all 192 practice games (pos, move, dropIn). It cannot fix N3. One new >=20 s pin: base 0 seed 3, t 137-172 s, flag not active in the window (fired 17.9-36.6 s), place 12 vs champion 16.
p52b.reuse: Drop-keep gate (stay within DROP_RUN_M and leave time before the drop run starts) can wrap any new movement goal.
p52b.outcome: C (unsuccessful: the fix never binds; behavior equals P52, which scored 4.23 vs 4.44)
p52b.disproof: Drop-ring arrivals below the champion on either practice base (0, 6000), or deaths <40 s no better than the champion's (written before the build was measured).
p52b.strength_kept: Early-death gain from early farming (F11: died<40 s 48->45, 38->37 in P52's Mac sim).
p52b.weakness_fixed: N3: P52's drop-ring loss (8->3 on 2000+3000) was real on the site (4.23 vs 4.44).
p52b.differs_from_P52: Same trigger and cube choice, plus the drop-keep gate: P52 could walk to a cube that took us out of drop-run range or made us late; P52b refuses those cubes and never early-farms during a drop run or with a landed reachable drop.
p52b.success: No drop-ring arrival loss vs the champion on EITHER practice base (0, 6000) while deaths <40 s stay below the champion's.
p52b.blocker: Flag-on P52b would be the same build as P52 (site LOSS, N3); LEARNING_STANDARD bans re-testing the same mechanism under a new name. Flip commit not made.
p52b.next_action: Coordinator: retire, or reassign a different N3 fix. N3's drop loss must come from where early farm leaves us at 60-70 s (position/cubes vs the drop at next_center), not from farming during a drop; a real fix would need a gate on the predicted drop area (next_center) before t=70 s, which is a different behavior.
p52b.untested_note: UNTESTED: N3's drop-ring loss may come from where early farm leaves us at 60-70 s relative to the next zone centre (where the 70 s drop is called), not from farming during a drop (no drop exists before 70 s). A placement fix was not built: practice bases 0/6000 show flat drops for P52 as-is, so the sim there cannot show whether it works. No P52c for now.
